Name: lunakatt's DCBurger style portraits for Wilford NPC
Author: lunakatt
Description:
[left][size=4]lunakatt's DCBurger Style Portraits for Wilford NPC

[size=3]This is another extension mod for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's High Res Portrait Mod[/url], this time for Wilford from FloranceBless's mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7313]Wilford - New Custom NPC[/url]﻿! [/size]

[/size]
[size=3]Required mods:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API [/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK - Platonymous Toolkit[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/size]
[size=4][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7313]Wilford - New Custom NPC[/url][/size][/size]

Install instructions:
1. Install the required mods listed
2. Extract the CP version of this mod into your mods directory
3. Run the game using SMAPI[/left]
[b][size=4]Go to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13599?tab=description]HD Portraits Patches for PyTK[/url] by purplexpresso to get a patch for the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10971]HD Portraits[/url] :D
[/size][/b]Thank you to purplexpresso, go show them some love on their mod page!

Thanks again to DCBurger for their support and their original portraits! xx
Thank you to FloranceBless for letting me create portraits for their boy Wilford, please go leave them some love on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7313]Wilford's mod page[/url]!

Check out my Stardew Valley Expanded portraits [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9029]here[/url]!


If you'd like, consider buying me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/lunakatt]Ko-fi[/url]!
